info.title: LedgerBook booking payment reminders
info.description: Local booking contract. New reminder-only plans use schedule_basis=reminders: dates and positive amounts, optional partial or empty plans, and no payment writes. Actual payments stay in payment history. Existing legacy and remaining_balance contracts remain supported.

post.summary: Create a booking with optional payment reminders
post.description: Reminder mode creates the booking charge and optional reminders; it never creates, links or reverses payments. New clients send schedule_basis=reminders with date/amount rows only. Partial and empty plans are allowed; total reminder amounts above remaining debt are rejected. Later confirmed payments reduce the earliest reminder first; full payment completes every reminder. Reversing a payment received before the saved plan may expose additional unscheduled debt. Customer account credit or other-booking payments never settle reminder rows. Administrator only. Atomically creates the GBP charge, booking, schedule, payment links, folders and invoice snapshot. With schedule_basis=remaining_balance, explicitly selected existing credits and newly paid rows reduce the target for unpaid rows. Existing credits are never posted again. Empty input defaults to one row for a positive remaining balance; fully paid bookings need no due row. Paid history is retained as linked completed rows to prevent double allocation. Legacy requests without schedule_basis validate all rows against instalment_total or amount. Identical key/payload retries return the existing booking; changed payload returns 409.

get.summary: Read a booking, its schedule and received-money totals
get.description: Administrators and the owning customer can read an active booking. Instalments are ordered by due date, then creation order/ID. paid_minor includes every approved, unreversed payment linked to this booking; remaining_minor=max(total_minor-paid_minor,0), overpaid_minor=max(paid_minor-total_minor,0). These use the booking charge, not instalment_total_minor. Reversed instalment payments return paid=false and null payment metadata.

patch.summary: Edit booking details and payment reminders
patch.description: Reminder mode changes only dates/amounts and booking details; unchanged booking totals and all payments remain untouched. expected_paid_minor and expected_payment_snapshot are required; stale payment snapshots return 409. Existing paid legacy rows remain in payment history. New clients send schedule_basis=reminders with date/amount rows only. Partial and empty plans are allowed; total reminder amounts above remaining debt are rejected. Later confirmed payments reduce the earliest reminder first; full payment completes every reminder. Reversing a payment received before the saved plan may expose additional unscheduled debt. Customer account credit or other-booking payments never settle reminder rows. Administrator only; full editable payload, expected_version and reason are required. Include persisted instalment IDs. Unchanged paid rows are retained without another credit. Changing a booking_instalment-source paid amount/date or marking it due reverses its original payment; a still-paid corrected row receives a replacement. The reversal is dated no earlier than the original payment or current business date, and a replacement uses the actual corrected paid_date. This also applies to staff-linked existing ledger payments. Receipt-approved source rows permit due-date edits but must be corrected in payment history before paid status/amount/date changes. Legacy requests reject omitted paid rows. To remove a paid row deliberately, mark it due and save its correction before removing it in another edit. Legacy matching rows without IDs can remain unchanged. Total changes reverse/replace the charge; calculation-total-only changes do not. All changes are atomic and audited. Identical key/body retries return the original committed response even after later changes. With schedule_basis=remaining_balance, only unpaid rows count against the booking amount less final approved unreversed payments; selected existing_payment_entry_ids link whole available credits. Omitted rows that are still actively paid are retained. Previously unallocated approved booking payments become completed rows when a plan is explicitly saved, preventing their money from reducing the new unpaid schedule twice. No existing records are rewritten on deployment.

get.summary: List whole existing customer payments available to link
get.description: Administrator only. Returns unreversed, nonfuture payments for the same organization/customer, either unassigned to a booking or approved for the optional booking_id and not yet assigned to an instalment. A payment already attached to a row is excluded. Results are ordered newest payment date/entry first and are not paginated. Availability and exact amount/date matching are checked again when the booking is saved. An existing payment can be assigned once, in full; partial allocations are unsupported. already_recorded_for_booking identifies payments already included in that booking's paid_minor so clients avoid double counting.

Amount.description: Positive GBP decimal text, up to 1,000,000,000,000.00. At most two fractional digits; zero, negatives, commas and exponent notation are rejected. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

paid.description: New rows default to due; PATCH omission retains a matched row status. Paid rows count as received money and are excluded from the remaining-balance schedule sum. Legacy mode includes paid rows in its full-schedule sum.

paid_date.description: Actual date received, no later than the current business date. Required for a new paid row unless payment_entry_id supplies it. When supplied for an existing payment, it must match that entry. Omit for unpaid rows.

payment_entry_id.description: Positive ledger-entry ID as decimal text, at most 9223372036854775807. Optional existing customer payment to link without posting a second credit. Requires paid=true and an exact whole-instalment amount match. Omit for unpaid rows.

id.description: Persisted instalment ID from GET. Required to deliberately change recorded paid rows; cannot belong to another booking.

departure_at.description: ISO date-time with an explicit UTC offset or Z.

instalment_total.description: Legacy positive GBP calculation target. Omission uses amount. Without schedule_basis, the full schedule must be within £5 of this target. Remaining-balance mode requires this field to be omitted or equal to amount; its actual target is derived from booking amount less received payments.

effective_date.description: Charge date. For a charge correction, cannot precede the current charge’s effective date. Also supplies the due date of an implicit remaining-balance row when instalments is empty.

idempotency_key.description: Use the same UUID and identical payload when retrying an uncertain response. Reusing a key with different input returns 409.

instalments.description: In reminder mode: zero to 100 positive date/amount rows. Their sum may be below, but cannot exceed, the current remaining booking balance. Empty means no reminders. Rows represent the outstanding amounts at save time; confirmed money is not deducted again. Legacy modes retain their prior rules.

schedule_basis.description: Use reminders for date/amount notices with no financial side effects. remaining_balance retains the older payment-linked plan; omission retains the legacy contract. A saved reminder plan must continue to use reminders.

items.description: Positive ledger-entry ID as decimal text, at most 9223372036854775807.

existing_payment_entry_ids.description: A nonempty selection requires schedule_basis=remaining_balance. Explicitly selected whole available payments belonging to this customer. Entries assigned to another booking, reversed entries and future payments are rejected. Links money without posting a duplicate credit; unselected customer payments are excluded from this booking’s paid total and plan target.
